entities.summary: Wang Jun was a Chinese business executive. He served as Chairman of the Poly Group, a state-owned conglomerate with businesses ranging from arms trading to antiquities. He also served as Chairman the state-owned China International Trust and Investment Corporation (CITIC) and held the rank of a government minister. He retired in 2006 after reaching the age of 65. He was born in Hunan to the Communist revolutionary elder Wang Zhen.
